record.question: Which one of the city is called Forbidden city?
record.explanation: Answer A: Lhasa (Tibet). Lhasa is the listed city historically described as the Forbidden City, reflecting restrictions on foreign access. Candler's first-hand account of entering Lhasa in 1904 documents that usage. This city nickname must be distinguished from the Beijing palace complex also called the Forbidden City. Historical/source note: Historical nickname of Lhasa among the printed city choices; not a reference to Beijing's palace complex. Reference: https://www.gutenberg.org/files/33359/33359-h/33359-h.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
